proposed_widenings.name: range field on ActivatedAbilityMechanics (or ActivatedAbilityHeader)
proposed_widenings.justification: The wand fires a ranged ray at a creature within 60 feet. ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no range field, so the tracer emits 'range Self' for the target attachment — factually wrong. MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics and TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics already carry a range field; the same field is needed on ActivatedAbilityMechanics for ranged activated items.
proposed_widenings.evidence: toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself

notes: Core mechanics encode cleanly: charge_pool(7), dawn regain(1d6+1), holding_item gate, Magic action cost, Con DC 15 save_gate, paralyzed on fail, repeat_save end_of_target_turn. Typecheck passes; tracer completes without throwing. The only gap is the 60-foot range, which ActivatedAbilityMechanics cannot express — the tracer emits 'range Self' instead. Additionally, the duration field (1 minute timed) is present in the JSON but the tracer does not render persist/expire nodes for ActivatedAbilityMechanics duration (tracer limitation, not a type-surface gap).
